steps.name: Passerby A
steps.text: Woah, are they shooting a movie or something?

steps.name: Passerby B
steps.text: Aren't those the Penguin Logistics people? They're fighting again?

steps.name: Passerby B
steps.text: Give 'em a left hook! Now right! C'mon! Yeah!

steps.name: Passerby A
steps.text: They always win every fight. It's boring.

steps.name: Passerby B
steps.text: Yeah. Hey, you mooks in black, don't lose too bad!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Ugh, it's such a pain when you can't use live ammo.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: How many times do we gotta tell ya, no live ammo downtown. Exusiai, behind ya!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Eep! That was close~ Thanks, Croissant.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Does this never end?! Texas!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Right... Sora with me, Exusiai with Croissant, divide and conquer. To the ends of the earth.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: ...what?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Aweso... I mean, affirmative.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Oh~ cut 'em in two, huh? No problem. That's my specialty!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: You might play it a bit safer, Exusiai. Our damage bill's gettin' mighty long...

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Hold on, what does 'to the ends of the earth' mean there?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: We regroup in an hour.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: What does it mean?!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: But how do we fight our way out?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I've got an idea...

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Wh- what the hell are you doing?! I ain't scared of you, angel girl!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Hop on, Croissant! This bike's pretty sweet, huh?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: You got it! Let's ride!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Hijacking? Good idea.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Alright, you're up.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Stay back, friggin' wolf.. You... Aieee! Not in the face! Fine, take the bike!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Get on, Sora.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Y- yeah okay!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Hold on tight. I can't let Exusiai outrun me.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: You could maybe, maybe go a little slower——

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Then I guess...

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: They left this kid behind?

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Sounds good to me. Let's get him!

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: What are these guys thinking?!

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Darn it...! I need a vehicle!

steps.name: Passerby A
steps.text: Hey, you looking for a bike? I could lend you one.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: A bicycle?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Well, beggars can't be choosers. Thanks!

steps.name: Passerby A
steps.text: Go get 'em!

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: That was a pretty bold thing you did there. Helping out Penguin Logistics...

steps.name: Passerby A
steps.text: You guys got wheels. You should be able to catch him.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Leave it. Don't mess with the civilians. Don't wanna get us in trouble.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: S- sorry. After him! Everybody get after him!

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Hmph...

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: 'Kidnap Bison, split Penguin Logistics and MDL, rub out Emperor,' that was your great plan.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Our goal is to take their place. No need to bury those idiots. I think you can do the math on this one?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Texas, she's Texas. Then you got the Laterano girl and the MDL princeling. You think we can leave 'em breathing and still sleep at night?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: We gotta salt the earth here.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: That's a good way to get a lot of eyes on us. We ain't the only seat at this table.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Hah! You scared?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Gotta know when to fold 'em, cazzo.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Getting down on my hands and knees for the Rat King was as low as I'm ever gonna go. All this time in Lungmen's turned you coward. Scared of your own damned tail.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: You done a lot for the Family, but you're lucky I ain't kicked you to the curb yet.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: You do what you gotta do. We can come back to that one.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Damn right. Now I gotta deal with Penguin Logistics my way.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: A stiff can't come back and bite you in the ass, capiche?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: ...you do it your way. But I'm just gonna warn you one last time: this ain't Siracusa. We're in Lungmen now.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: And it's after we blew it in Siracusa that I realized: we don't pass up an opportunity. We're not gonna compromise, negotiate, and fall into another trap.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: We're gonna use everything we got to totally wipe out the competition.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: We're gonna do this the old way, like the true Sicilians we are.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Right. The Family don't need cowards... the Family don't need rubes.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Send some guys into the slums to find the Rat King. Let him know the deal's changed.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Mr. Capone, you know if we can't get the Rat King to see sense...

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Listen, if we're gonna do business in Lungmen, can we really let a rat hang over our heads the whole time?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: We gotta do something about him sooner or later.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Go down this list of Lungmenites we know have some connection to the Rat King.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: We don't have a lotta time here. I need results tonight. Get going.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Did I do anything with all these years in Lungmen...?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: You screwed up, Gambino Ricci. Really screwed the pooch.
